in_hebrew.name: Kasimir
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Full of sorrow, purity
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Kasimir הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Slavic name Kazimierz, meaning 'full of sorrow'. In Christian tradition, the name is associated with St. Casimir, a Polish prince and patron saint of Lithuania. He is known for his deep faith, purity, and dedication to God.
